plugins.name: ship-audit
plugins.description: Pre-launch checklist gate: is it safe to show a real user. Static scans for secrets in tracked files, env completeness, debug flags, stack-trace leaks, rate limiting, auth basics, HTTPS/headers, and migration reversibility; BLOCKS launch on hard failures, WARNs on soft ones. Dynamic checks stay honest: verified in code or listed as needs manual verification, never claimed as PASS.
